profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
⇒ Senior backend engineer skilled in scalable distributed systems, cloud-native APIs, event-driven architecture, and high-throughput monetization workflows for retail and eCommerce platforms.
⇒ Collaborative architecture ownership across microservices, data pipelines, GCP migration, database modernization, and backend platform initiatives with pragmatic designs and clear trade-offs.
⇒ Cross-team collaboration with engineering, product, architecture, analytics, leadership, and partner teams to align priorities, clarify requirements, support delivery planning, and guide production readiness.
⇒ Mentorship and execution support through design reviews, implementation guidance, debugging support, operational playbooks, and clear technical documentation.
⇒ Business-impact focused engineering supporting Kroger monetization systems powering $529M+ annual onsite revenue and 31% YoY growth.
⇒ Operational excellence and data-driven optimization across observability, resiliency, performance tuning, cost optimization, experimentation, and AI/ML workflows, including 25–30% response-time gains, ~66% database cost reduction, 60% ML runtime improvement, and 50% compute cost reduction.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering lead for Kroger’s onsite monetization platform powering $529M+ annual revenue and 31% YoY growth across PLA, TOA, search, and StartMyCart ad experiences. Drive backend architecture, experimentation, ranking, measurement accuracy, and platform reliability for high-throughput ad-serving systems.
Led monetization initiatives across ad density, auction ranking, relevance gating, UPC filtering, visibility-based measurement, and reporting accuracy—improving ad quality, experiment evaluation, and revenue yield. Partner with engineering, product, architecture, analytics, and leadership teams to translate business OKRs into technical roadmaps and scalable delivery plans.
Architected major distributed systems and data platform improvements, including Cassandra-to-YugabyteDB migration, publisher quality scoring, auction-event analytics pipelines, and GCP-based service modernization—delivering 25–30% response-time improvement, ~66% database cost reduction, and improved latency consistency across regions.
Scaled AI/ML inventory prediction capabilities from pilot to 23K DSD UPCs, redesigned inference workflows to reduce runtime by 60%, and optimized cloud capacity to reduce compute spend by 50% while enabling faster inventory signal availability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on various projects including managing customer account information (Loyalty, Club card, Pharmacy, etc.) , Identity management, Okta, syncing real time customer information for reporting tools.

Development:
>Design and develop API’s using Event Sourcing, CQRS pattern of reactive programming for managing customer account information. 
>Streamed real time customer data stored in Database to Snowflake using Confluent Platform.
>Designed and developed backend for managing identity using Okta. 
>Worked on designing and implementing OTP flow during signIn/singUp for banner websites/mobile app.

Technologies:
Reactive Java 8+, Microsoft Azure, APIM, Okta, Jenkins, Apache Spark, Confluent Platform, MongoDB, Spring Boot, Hystrix, Maven, Protobuf, gRPC, Swagger, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, JUnit, Mockito

positions.title: Software Development Associate Manager
positions.description:
Client: Google					 	       
AI/Machine Learning Platform:
Google AI/ML platform is a Machine Learning based automation solution designed for Google Financial Application areas. Platform aims to automate repeatable tasks (Route, Triage, Assign and Resolution), enhances tools for users (Assist, Chat, Process Automation) and improves service availability through Monitoring Tools & Process Automation. 
The project involves the development of API based solutions on Google Cloud platform and Google in-house technologies

Responsibilities:
> Lead and Manage Google and Accenture team for project deliveries
> Provide support for the product to internal team and end users
> Provide training to new hires or existing employees for Google Technologies
> Play role of Scrum master for the project
> Assign and oversee day-to-day job duties of team as well as review their work
> Transform business use cases into scalable technology solutions using AI/ML and Cloud based platforms
> Convert POC to full-fledged application

Development:
> Developed AI/ML platform UI in Google Cloud Platform using Angular
> Designed and developed chat widget JavaScript tag and integrated with Angular UI
> Designed and developed Chrome Extension to resolve tickets
> Data gathering, train, evaluate ML Models and Integrate it with application
> Design and develop micro-services and perform end to end integration
> Design and development of Google Internal APIs using Google Guice
> Worked on Google Cloud Functions that respond to Cloud events through server-less environment
> Design and Implementation of functionality according to business requirements

Technologies:
Java 8+, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, AppEngine, Cloud Endpoints, Dialogflow,  BigQuery, Spanner, Cloud Pub/Sub, Cloud Load Balancing, Buganizer, Bazel, Google Hangouts API, Google Drive API, Protobuf, gRPC, Guava Libraries of Java, Guice Framework, Angular Framework, Javascript, TypeScript, Tensorflow, JUnit, Mockito

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
E-Commerce Application
Designed and maintained shopping web application using Spring, Hibernate and Angular. In this application users could Login, search for products, add/remove to cart, etc. Employees could also add, modify and remove products. 

Development:
> Developed new functionalities, enhancements and customizations based on requirements. 
> Designed UI using Angular, HTML5, CSS3
> Build REST API using Spring Boot
> Debugging, troubleshooting bugs and identifying the root cause
> Unit test cases were written using Junit

Online Banking application
Designed and developed bank web portal for bank customers, employees and management. The application allows customers to create account, deposit, withdraw, transfer funds, and modify personal information. It also allows employees to manage customer information and bank management to manage the employees.

Development:
> Design and development of presentation layers using JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery
> Designed and Developed REST web services using Spring
> Spring Security for authentication and authorization of user
> JavaMail API was used to send relevant notifications and JasperReport was used to generate report template for customers, and employee
> Created and managed the log files application.log, error.log and server.log by using Log 4j tool
> Performed unit testing, for the developed code, by using JUnit

Technologies:
  Java 8, Angular, Hibernate 4, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST web service, JavaScript, HTML 5, Bootstrap, JavaMail, Velocity, SoapUI, Maven, Tomcat, JasperReport

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Online Pizza Ordering
It’s a web based application comprising three modules- Customer, Employee and Administrator. It allows customers to create custom pizza, select pizza from available menu, order pizza, choose delivery option and do payment. Employee can monitor pizza order and update order status and send notification to customers about status. Admin can add and edit ingredients, see order details, add / update employees, view order details, view feedback.

Development:
> Developed and designed web pages using JSP, HTML5 and CSS3.
> Designed and developed Customer, Employee and Administrator modules using Spring MVC
> Created REST web services using Spring Framework
> Maven was used as a project building tool.
> Different test cases were developed for order management, ingredient management, pizza removal 
    management, etc. using Junit

Technologies:
Java 8, Hibernate 4, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST web service, JavaMail, JSP, Servlet, JavaScript, HTML 5, Bootstrap, CSS3, Tomcat 8.0, Maven

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
University Website application
Designed, developed and maintained website for student, faculty management. The application allows students to create account, manage their profile, can view their test results. Faculties can add their lecture notes, academic information, etc.

Development:
> Designed and developed Student login, Faculty login, Student Course Registration, etc. pages using JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap.
> Used JavaScript and jQuery for client-side validation.
> Used AJAX for communication between front end and backend services.
> Designed REST endpoints for managing students, faculties profile
> Spring MVC Framework was used for developing the web application
> Developed automated email messaging using Web Logic Messaging JMS service.
> Used Jasper Report for generating student, faculty reports.
> Used Junit for unit testing the web service code and other functionalities

Technologies:
Java 7, Hibernate 4, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST web service, JSP, Servlet, JavaScript, HTML 5, Bootstrap, CSS3, Web Logic, Oracle

positions.title: Engineering Project Trainee
positions.description:
•	Designed interactive software for viewing real time data and data acquisition circuit using AVR microcontroller for lunar moisture detector of India’s LADEE mission (Software- LabVIEW and BASCOM) 
•	Used Chang’e 1(China) satellite’s Microwave radiometer data for retrieval of water/ice content on Moon.  
•	Designed and developed GUI for obtaining emissivity of the Moon. 
	Software includes the feature of obtaining microwave brightness temperature and infrared brightness temperature. 
	User can add, delete, and update files. Specific plot feature is also provided to see various plots of particular latitude-longitude combination. 
	There is an option for querying the software as to find particular data (emissivity, infrared temperature and microwave temperature) for particular latitude longitude combination. 
	User can also add, update and delete feature like plot craters.
•	Performed experiments on JSC-1A (Johnson Space Center number one) Lunar soil simulant to obtain emissivity of Lunar surface
	Samples were prepared and then filled in C-band waveguide connected to microwave Vector Network Analyzer (Rohde & Schwarz ZVB-8), to measure various S-parameters of the waveguide. 
	VNA was calibrated using standard ‘Through-Open-Short-Match (TOSM)’ two port calibration technique before connecting device under test. 
	One of the ports of VNA is connected to the adapter through co-axial cable and the other adapter is connected to another port of VNA. 
	Various soil samples are filled inside the guide to alter the attenuation caused by the presence of water.
